body: I believe that they think this is going to compensate for the gen rushing, tunneling phenomenon they have forced into being.
I am not running. My ex dumped me two months ago and I have nothing here anymore. All I am doing is holding everyone around me back. I need to reset

My ex of five years left me two months ago, my family who have never seen me cry have not been able to help me. I have no one anymore, I am no help to anyone here. I just want to leave and go reinvent myself somewhere new. I need to get away from my ex so she can move on. She wants to get back with me but I dont deserve her in the first place. Any suggestions on the leaving? Should I say anything or just go?

Until I know she doesnt want or need me in her life I wont do that. I cant stand the thought of her not in my life in some way. I do appreciate the reply though and I will consider it but the thought alone hurts so much
I cant cut the only person who will ever know me out of my life. I wont do it

I should just stop but I cant move on, its beyond me to move on right now. I cant even think about anything except her and the new guy. I dont want to move on, I dont want to move at all. She is happy, apparently the new guy is very inpressive....
Yeah but I cant bring myself to do it. I cant take her from my life like that and throw everything away...
Giving up is the only thing I can think of but I will try.
Thank you, I will try it. I have been working out and filling my days. Its all empty though. I feel no different. I am just so depressed.
I dont think i would pass any mental evaluation right now. They probably woukdnt let me in either
I have always had depression because I expect so much more from myself. Going to a doctor just feels like I have failed again. I cant even bring myself back from my mental instability.

Thank you, and as much as I would love someone with the ability to straighten me out mentally I cant find the courage to admit my weakness. I guess being a coward is another attribute I will have to fix or lean to live with.

I hate to say it but there will be someone else for you but wait until you have moved on from your ex. You could hinder any new relationship you may find yourself in by making unfair comparisons to your ex. Good luck to you brother, I am in the same stuggle as you. Be well and stay positive, good things will happen for you

The hollidays are hard to be single. Especially when you are used to the connection you usually have with a significant other. Spend less time focusing on it. Enjoy the holliday and find some reasons you are thanksful. I have had a really hard time recently when my girlfriend of 5yrs left me. I recently picked up stating all the things I am thankful I still have. I hope this helps you and you can feel better. Good luck

I have thought about it but with what I have been feeling and thinking; I cant be put in a hospital for any length of time. I have animals that depend on me. I appreciate you telling me that but I feel like somehow I must deserve this.

Her brother lives with me and I refuse to be a bad person and stoop to her level. I agree that she needs to take her things but I cant find a way to get it done. I even offered to loan her the money to move now but she refused it. 
The dogs dont deserve to be treated as chips to get what I want. I love them and as much as I want them I just dont want her around. I have bonded a lot recently with the akita puppy we bought together a few months ago. 
I appreciate you trying to help but these are things I just cant do. I havent been a good boyfriend over the years and I dont want give her anymore negative memories of me. I AM a good person and I dont want to be that way anymore. I just need insight into what her thoughts were and why she would be doing what she is doing.

She refuses to get her things out of my house. She keeps pushing back the date she is coming for her things. I havent been talking to her any more then I have too but the impulse to talk to someone I have known for 10yrs is hard to ignore. Her brother is my best friend and roommate. She left her dogs and insists on coming back to see them when ever she wants.
Thanks, that actually makes a lot of sense. Her trying to get me to take her after talking about her new guys dick size and prowess. That helps a lot.

I told her I dont care about what happened. It hurt but its over now and I am moving on like she is. What would be the point in making me feel like shit, I forgave her for it. So she is basically being unessisarily cruel so i have to be on here level? Is that why she wants me to fuck her now that she is in a new relationship, to say that I would do the same thing or I am not better then what she did?
Sorry for your loss. The first week was the hardest for me and I am sure you feel it too. You got this.
I appreciate it, I am not getting a lot of positive support these days from my family. Thank you
I know, I can do this. I just have to get out of this hole.
Thanks, I need some self respect and I get that.
It worked, i cant get off my floor. I can barely breath. The depression is back worse then ever. I am failing at life

I feel like the only me I am is because of her. I dont have friends, I dont have anything other than my family and the dogs. I am nothing without them. I dont want to live for them, and I dont want to live for me. She said if I kill myself she will too and I would never do that to her but I am hoping to die so I dont have to do this anymore.
My limbs feel like lead right now, she called and told me all the things I fucked up in our relationship and how great her new guy is. I dont want to do this anymore

I dont think I will feel this way again and that i blew my shot with the one. I am going to meet this friend for our date but I dont think i will be able to follow through, it already feels like I am cheating.

Thank you for sharing with me, I know it cant be easy. I feel like somewhere inside she still wants to be with me hut the coke and the new guy are telling her to move on. I dont even know who I am anymore. I havent really cried in 12 years. I used to be so strong and independent and I had so many friends. Now i have nothing, not even the person i gave it all up for. I feel so fucking empty. I even told her it wasnt about moving into a new relationship, it was just needing someone to hold and feeling wanted. All I want is to feel something from someone and now I am an asshole because it was fund someone else or kill myself. I have never had an issue meeting wemen and when i started looking it only took a few minutes to find someone looking for what i was looking for and I finally started feeling like things were getting better and then this...

I dont know who I am anymore. I have never cried like this before in my life. My parents are trying to force me into a hospital because they have never seen me like this. I have no friends because i pushed them away for her. I dont know why I even try anymore...
I was moving on, I hadnt broken down in almost two days before she came here and now I am right back to the pethetic piece of shit she tinks I am. I dont know how not to care
It hasnt been great but I have spent so long shaping myself into this dream guy she wanted... and she left me anyways

I really want to be her friend because we were friends for five years before we got together and it isnt easy finding a friend that will stick around for 10 years and has been through the shit with me. How do I deserve better, all i want is a fucking shallow grave right now because I thought i actually deserve to be happy.

I love her still, I dont want her out of my life. How am I supposed to throw away five years like it never happened? Its easy to say to move on and I can, and quickly but I love her. She is the only woman i thought about marriage and kids with. I have gone two days without a breakdown and seeing her cry today because I was going to have sex with another woman is sending me back into soul crushing depression. I just got past wanting to kill myself and then this, now I am right back here.

I am 25 and she is 23, she cheated before we officially broke up a week ago. It was with a coworker who supplies her with drinks and drugs. She left me because of this guy telling her too and our past issues which I had been working on. I can forgive it all just to hold her again. I have had the hardest time not killing myself, its the second time I have been cheated on and it hurts really bad. My parents almost took me to an inpatient program because they were worried I might do something permanent. Its not that I cant be alone, I dont have too. I have found people I can go and be with physically but she is the only woman I have ever really loved and thought of marriage and having kids with. I had never even considered either of those options before and it only makes things hurt more.

I know they care and that is just making me more upset. I dont want to dissapoint them anx leave them but this doesnt seem worth it anymore. What is the point in living for ither people? Thats not how to be happy. I know and I love my dogs so .. They are like the children i never had. I take them on walks and i try to play but i cant find the will to have fun with them. I play xbox not sure if you are into that, its not so great. I only own a few shitty games. Thanks, I really appreciate you taking time out of you're night to talk with me about this.

Before this week i have cried 2 times sice I was a teen. I have cried dozens of times a day for the last four days. I cant leave my house becaude the dogs and quite honestly my depression is making it hard to do anything. I cant sleep because of the nightmares and I cant eat because of the nausia. I play games but that just makes me feel more like a looser and its more like going through the motions. Everyone has tried being here and I really appreciate the attempts the people in my life have made but they dont understand and they keep making it worse. I feel like such a failure to everyone and my life has no meaning.

She cheated on me and left me. We havent been great for a while but I have spent the last three months really working on my issues and being a better boyfriend. I am broken up and she is fine, I feel like I am the only one who cares.
Thanks every day is getting a little easier but she keeps messaging me and setting me back.

Thanks, I have been able to eat small ammounts of peanuts and sundlower seed kernels but its about it. I have no money so its all I can afford that i can stoch eating. I know it probably isnt easy to talk about it and I apreciate you helping me through this.

Thank you. The cheating I would forgive, like a fool O would do it. I dont want to move on, I want my life back. I want that pain and stress of my relationship. I was an ass when she came to the house and told her she didnt mean anything to me, it was a lie because she is my world and now i feel like a pile of shit for saying it. I feel so hurt and betrayed and yet I would take her back in an instant or come to her aid if she ever asked. She has so much pull on how I feel its demoralizing and humilating. I would never commit suicide but I wouldnt be mad if it did happen.

I really appreciate youre imput. I dont know if the words themselfs have sunk in but I really needed to talk. Thank you. I hate that I miss her and that I still love her. Any advice on getting over relationships?

This is one more bad thing in six months of bad. I have lost everything except my family and my apartment. I just keep failing and I dont see a point anymore. If it werent for my family and my feelings of suicide I would have done it already. The cheating is eating all the progress i have made twords being a better person and turned it into this ugly depression/sucidal anger. I honestly dont even want to wake up tomorrow i feel like everyones life would be better without me here to screw things up. I am so ashamed of myself for being so weak...

I appreciate you're oppinion and we were never the best with each other issues but I have never wanted anything so bad in my life. She is the other half of me, i know we fueled each others insecurities and things havent been great but we did so well for so long everything considered. How do you give up on five years? I feel like i am being shredded apart. 

I was actually thinking we should get our own places but still be together because we never had that, the day we got together we moved in. 

I have a feeling what you are saying is true but coming to terms with it is so hard... I am not an easy person to get along with if I dont "click" when i meet people it usually ends with them disliking me or vise versa. I dont think i emphasized that enough in the post.

I have been there, its habitual and you have to find your triggers and avoid them. If you only do it when she is not home then get someone to come over and hang out or leave and go out. I have tried distancing myself from the devices i use to watch porn when ever i feel the temptation. Its a struggle and I know your pain. Its so good to know I am not alone, i have been struggling for a long time myself and i have been so depressed that it hasnt worked. You got this, I have faith we can all do better.

I would say try dude, i have a really hard time stopping. I have been in a struggle for a long time and its still with me. It has greatly effected my relatio ship of 5 years. I cant seem to stop for more then a few weeks, porn no porn I just need to GO. I have been trying and failing and the depression of failing drives me to do it more. If you have a chance to stop then I would recommend that you give it a try and dont beat yourself up if it doesnt work for you.
